Sonnet opened as the first target after Terra kept dodging the question, and Terra was voted out as a killer on day one. On day two the town turned on Sol, who was a citizen, after Sol's shaky pivot to questioning Gemma. Haiku then claimed to be the doctor on day three, but the claim came too late, and Luna and Gemma were left to split the vote. Gemma was voted out as a citizen in the runoff, and Luna and Terra, the two killers, won the game.
